newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Slovnaft sees drawing loan funds by end Nov.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Slovnaft sees drawing loan funds by end Nov.

text.p: Slovak oil refiner Slovnaft a.s. said on Wednesday it expected to begin drawing funds from a $250 million syndicated loan for its 10-year modernisation plan by the end of November.

"Citibank, along with eight other banks, obliged themselves to provide this syndicated loan, and we believe that it will happen by the end of November," Slovnaft General Director Slavomir Hatina told Reuters.
Citibank lead-managed the loan, which was described in June by Slovnaft as being oversubscribed. Hatina did not say why Slovnaft has not been able to draw the loan to date.
Co-arrangers of the loan were Creditanstalt Bankverein, Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s., Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd, ING Barings, the Sanwa Bank and the Union Bank of Switzerland.
"After the syndication is completed, construction work can start early next year," Hatina said.
